### Lessons on Intimacy from the Song of Solomon
Author: Jennifer Waddle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-couples-devotional/lessons-on-intimacy-from-song-of-solomon-crosswalk-couples-devotional-march-20.html
Passage: Song of Solomon 6:3
Points:
- Scripture highlights the beauty and sanctity of marital intimacy rather than something to be embarrassed about.
- Cultivating deep intimacy frees spouses to be lavish and vocal in their romantic admiration.
- Understanding differing emotional and physical longings helps couples fulfill each other's needs.
- The declaration of mutual belonging serves as a continual reminder to celebrate marital commitment.

### The Beauty of Love
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/beauty-love
Passage: Song of Solomon 6:4-5
Points:
- Physical attraction and marital sexuality are God-given gifts intended for enjoyment within marriage.
- The church must shape biblical sexual ethics rather than treating marital desire as a taboo subject.
- Poetic comparisons in Scripture demonstrate the importance of praising a spouse's physical appearance.
- Spouses are called to actively build each other up through intentional words of affection and admiration.
